_notice: Verdicts on the two lot-source supplier names that reach two rows on one framework's own brief supplier list. Written 18/11/2026.
rule: The brief's supplier list is a capture of the owner's published page, verified against that page's own stated supplier count, and is never edited to resolve a Hub-side ambiguity. A lot attaches to a brief row only where the seed holds BOTH the notice's name and that row verbatim on one record.

companiesHouse.name: CLINISUPPLIES GB LIMITED
companiesHouse.address: 1 Blackmoor Lane, Croxley Park, Watford, England, WD18 8GA

frameworks.why: Two real companies, not one row printed twice. The notice names "Clinisupplies Limited", the registered name of 04013240, the company the Hub's Clinisupplies record resolves to, and that record holds both that name and the "Clinisupplies Ltd" row verbatim. No row was picked any other way.
frameworks.residual: 02503030 still has no Hub record and must not become an alias of 04013240 — different numbers are evidence they are distinct. It also still key-collapses onto the Clinisupplies record wherever a brief row is resolved to a company, because company_match.key() strips the "GB". Narrowing that would move award routing repo-wide, so it is a separate question.

frameworks.why: Also two real rows, not a duplicate, so there is nothing to de-duplicate. Food, which Lou ruled out of scope for Hub records on 17/11/2026, so no record is to be added for the entity the notice names. The only Nestle-keyed Hub record, Nestle Health Science UK, is the clinical nutrition arm and holds neither row verbatim — only a bare "Nestle", which its own 17/11/2026 verdict rules out as a way of naming one of several Nestle entities. Commit fd12566 attached the lots to the "Nestle UK" row; because app/company-report.js renders a company rather than a row, that published a confectionery and beverages Lot 1 and Lot 13 on the clinical nutrition arm's card, and it was reverted the same day.
frameworks.whatWouldChangeIt: NHS Supply Chain printing the entity in full on the brief, or a Find a Tender notice naming the awardee with its registration number.

warningAfterThisRun: The gate's TWO OR MORE rows line counts 1 name, Beverages/"Nestle UK Ltd", decided above. It is a DECIDED state, not a backlog item.
